title: CT-only segmentation: Astra efforts close, Sol localization weaker
claim: On one identical frozen CT-only task, fresh Astra/xhigh, Astra/medium and Sol/xhigh attempts completed with semantic macro Dice0.73803,0.73419 and0.32907. Both Astra runs preserve10 matched identities. All frozen scores independently replay exactly; geometry and effort differences remain descriptive.
limitations: One public case and one attempt per condition; no population ranking or causal reasoning-effort effect.
GT is a reviewed research reference, not independent clinical adjudication.
No clinical pass threshold; retain native continuous unclassified outcomes.
Identity assignment is conditional on geometric overlap.
Token counts accumulate across calls; operator effort separate.
No observed retrieval does not rule out training exposure or opaque model-service traffic.
